The package V10-server-handoff-v1 stays the historical baseline; this protocol modifies it only where the decision says so (supersedes).

m1_rule.objective: F_b(W): head objective of the current batch, on the current fixed features, with the same negative reference

definitions.Delta_b: grad_W F_b(0) = QuadraticHead.delta of the batch's own snapshot

m1_rule.stop_rule: stop with stop_reason gap_tolerance when G_b(W) <= tau_b; otherwise iterate to the cap (stop_reason iteration_budget_exhausted, converged false, actual gap kept: approximate head)

reference.is_not: the gap at the warm start
reference.W_later_batches: warm start from the previous training batch's W

m1_rule.strict_absolute_mode: kept for the numerical audit only (absolute tolerance, require_converged=True); never the training rule

rules: no zero tolerance passed to the solver (the phase-1 backend rejects tolerance <= 0)
W = 0 is the maximiser of this negative-semidefinite quadratic empirical objective; it is not population independence

m1_rule.near_fp32_resolution: keep a same-input fp64 numerical diagnostic for references near fp32 resolution; no global switch of training to fp64 without an actual failure
m1_rule.reference_source: the same constructed QuadraticHead.delta is used for the reference and the solve (no extra moment pass for the reference); any added moment pass or HVP updates the counters and the cost

log_fields_per_batch.note: solver flag; true only for gap_tolerance or zero_reference_gap (contract m1.log_fields)

log_field_rules.tolerance_effective: tau_b passed to the solver (null for zero_reference_gap)
log_field_rules.gap_scope: current fixed-feature empirical head objective before the outer feature update of this step

targeted_acceptance_new.check: zero-head start: from W = 0 with Delta_b != 0 the solver iterates (relative gap 1 > 0.01) and W, J and the encoder objective gradient become nonzero

targeted_acceptance_new.decision_item: warm start 与零头基准不同
targeted_acceptance_new.check: warm start: gap_start = G_b(W_start) is logged separately and the threshold uses G_b(0) of the same batch, not gap_start
zero reference: Delta_b exactly 0 returns W = 0, stop_reason zero_reference_gap, no division by zero, no zero tolerance passed to the solver
cap reached: returns W and the actual gap with converged false and stop_reason iteration_budget_exhausted (require_converged=False)
counts: hvp_calls and moments_passes equal the actual Hessian-vector products and moment passes (including any added for the reference)

revalidation.t01: rerun every T01 part under the new code hash and re-merge provenance
revalidation.t02: remeasure only the affected M1 configurations and the budget they change

m1_rule.checkpoint: encoder, feature maps and W saved as one indivisible checkpoint; no final FIT refit in the main protocol; registration keeps the model fixed and keeps geometry gradients
m1_rule.interpretation: the gap certifies only the sub-optimality of the fixed-feature empirical head problem; it bounds neither the encoder gradient error nor the population S error
m1_rule.evidence_scope: the relative rule removes the batch-noise-dependent start; the forced-30 decrease (about 0.92%) does not show that tau_b is reachable within 100 iterations; the T02 cap-bound gap medians of the phase-1 report are absolute gaps, not per-batch relative zero-head gaps

precision_environment.policy: every Torch method of the main tables runs under this one recorded effective configuration; the protocol pins the actual versions and switches, never 'torch default'
observed_sources: T01 CUDA part provenance in TORCH_VALIDATION.json / GEOMETRY_GRADIENT_CHECK.json (adapter_cuda, core_tol_cuda, geometry_cuda, verify_torch_cuda)

record_contract.when: after all imports, in every job, before the first measured step

override_env_vars.rule: record the raw value, or JSON null when the variable is unset; the key must be present; never assume unset

record_contract.raw_field_rule: cuda_matmul_fp32_precision is stored as the raw string (phase 1: 'none'); it is not rewritten to 'ieee' and not used as a setting value
record_contract.api_rule: manage precision through one torch 2.9 API set and record effective values; do not mix the old and new TF32 switches; 'highest' matmul precision does not imply IEEE convolutions

precision_environment.native_systems: an external system's extra precision constraint is named and costed with the method
precision_environment.no_extra_grid: no complete scientific grid is opened for IEEE / fp64 in this batch
precision_environment.evidence_scope: the geometry diagnostic shows lower numerical error with IEEE convolutions in that comparison; it does not show that TF32 caused the V9 registration non-reproducibility or that it changes task accuracy

infonce.registration_energy: J(tanh f), ordinary perm1, within-scene reference; negative permutation, search support and comparison rule fixed within one registration

negatives_perm1_perm8.sampler: uniform derangement: rejection of ordinary uniform permutations with a fixed point, or a validated equivalent uniform algorithm

negatives_perm1_perm8.gate: small-n exhaustive enumeration: the mean value and gradient over all derangements equal the complete U objective

target.natural_registration: unchanged: within-scene V with ordinary permutations (fixed points allowed)
target.caveat: for a fixed T independent of the evaluation sample the V Q-term carries a 1/n joint-distribution part; the finite-sample formula does not make the trained and selected maximum J an unbiased estimate of S

generator.rule: one complete suite (all 12 conditions, FIT/CAL/EVAL) per data root seed via generate_suite(root_seed=...); record generator and sample hashes; truth only for the evaluator

MF.implementation: SimplexBilinearCritic(m, m, K, K): Linear + softmax per side
MF.init: current PyTorch default Linear initialisation with a frozen RNG order; the three MF methods share the corresponding initial state; no method gets a separately searched initialisation

MLP.architecture: concat(one-hot x, one-hot y) -> Linear(2m,64) -> GELU -> Linear(64,64) -> GELU -> Linear(64,1); T = tanh f
MLP.perm1_perm8: same structure and same initial state

training.lr_tied: one candidate shared by all learned modules
training.M1_rule: m1_rule of this protocol (relative zero-head gap)

tuning_suite.candidate_order: learning rate ascending; MF_VCS_M1 cap ascending within each learning rate; ordinal within (condition, method)
tuning_suite.selection: per (condition, method): maximise the complete empirical U-J on the tuning suite's independent CAL samples over candidates x checkpoints; ties -> earlier checkpoint -> frozen candidate ordinal; the selected lr / cap are frozen for every formal replicate of that (condition, method)
tuning_suite.truth_access: none: training and CAL selection read samples only (load_samples); truth only via the evaluator (load_evaluation_truth)

conditional_algorithm.rule: own table; never pooled with the 10 data replicates into 12 identically distributed replicates

replicates.checkpoint_selection: each replicate selects its checkpoint only from its own CAL samples (complete empirical U-J; ties -> earlier checkpoint)
replicates.pairing_unit: the data replicate (bias, variance, RMSE with finite-replicate uncertainty)
replicates.rng: separate data, model-initialisation and permutation streams; every method on a data root seed sees the same observations

capacity.hyperparameters: inherit the K16 tuning-suite selection of the same (condition, method)
capacity.interpretation: capacity response under fixed training rules (includes optimisation effects); not an independently optimised capacity curve

smoke.rule: one condition, all five families, full 2000-step trainings with the actual full training cost measured, before any grid unit; the phase-1 head-only estimate is not a measured budget
smoke.over_budget: if the measured resources exceed the original order of magnitude, record the new budget and the completable scope first; never drop seeds, pick conditions or change the grid afterwards

error_decomposition: population approximation error of the learned critic (E_M(T-eta)^2 = S - J_pop(T), evaluator enumerates at most m^2 = 1024 cells)
conditional permutation variance on the same base data

saturated_FIT_table.formulas: \hat p_{xy}=N_{xy}/n,\quad \hat q^U_{xy}=\frac{N_xN_y-N_{xy}}{n(n-1)},\quad \hat q^V_{xy}=N_xN_y/n^2,\quad T^*_{xy}=\frac{\hat p_{xy}-\hat q_{xy}}{\hat p_{xy}+\hat q_{xy}}
saturated_FIT_table.role: empirical optimum of the saturated FIT-table function class; no truth in training; not a trained MF feature
saturated_FIT_table.caveat: an MLP can also aggregate by cell counts in this discrete setting; no general MF-vs-MLP compute-advantage inference

metrics.rulsif: RuLSIF exact moments join the quadratic-risk comparison after implementation and checks
metrics.non_S_outputs: InfoNCE, DV, NWJ etc. get no S-truth RMSE

units_file.id_scheme: T03_<SMK|CAL|MAIN|ALGO|CAP>_<n>, numbered in the frozen order of each block

order.CAL: condition -> method -> lr ascending -> cap ascending
order.capacity: data root seed -> condition -> method -> K

conventions.lr: 1e-4 / 3e-4 / 1e-3 for CAL and smoke rows; CAL = the CAL-selected value of the same (condition, method); CAL_K16 = the K16 CAL selection inherited by a capacity row
conventions.cap: MF_VCS_M1 only (10 / 30 / 100, CAL or CAL_K16); NA otherwise

selection_rule.SMOKE_NONE: smoke: implementation checks and full-cost measurement; outputs never enter any selection
selection_rule.CAL_UJ_SELECT: tuning suite: candidate x checkpoint selection per (condition, method) by the complete empirical U-J on CAL; ties -> earlier checkpoint -> frozen candidate ordinal
selection_rule.OWN_CAL_UJ_CKPT: formal replicate: hyperparameters fixed from the tuning suite; checkpoint selected only on this replicate's own CAL samples by the complete empirical U-J; ties -> earlier checkpoint

conventions.depends_on: ';'-joined unit ids that must be complete first (CAL rows: every smoke row; formal rows: the CAL candidates of the same condition and method)

steps.status: LANDED_NOT_FROZEN (this protocol and the phase-1 report corrections)

steps.en: implement the relative zero-head M1 rule and its logs plus targeted checks; rerun and merge all T01 parts under the new code hash; then update the affected M1 T02 rows and BUDGET

steps.text_cn: 冻结首批公共协议、manifest、候选顺序和成本上限；开展 BF 的四族 CAL/DEV。并行编写 T03，先生成检查与 smoke，再按已定网格实施。
steps.en: freeze the batch-1 common protocol, manifest, candidate order and cost ceilings; run BF CAL/DEV for the four families; write T03 in parallel (generation checks and smoke first, then the frozen grid)

steps.text_cn: 补齐基线适配、T01/T02 和冻结附件，在同一公共协议下补跑；记录成功、失败、超预算及完整累计成本。

steps.text_cn: EPFL 满足图像级和宿主接入条件后单独激活；完整 V10 方法选择冻结后再启用 BF TEST_REPEAT。所有当前数据结果标为开发或重复基准。

execution_order.parallel_development_cn: 并行开展的 T03 与基线开发使用独立 worktree 或固定提交；BF 作业始终运行已经验收的冻结代码快照。当前 code hash 覆盖 src/v10 与 scripts/v10 的全部已跟踪代码，新代码合入后按既有 provenance 规则更新验证，不沿用旧代码身份的 PASS；T02 仅重测实际受影响的路径。
execution_order.parallel_development_en: T03 and baseline development run in an independent worktree or at a fixed commit; BF jobs always run the accepted frozen code snapshot; merged new code is revalidated under the provenance rule (no PASS carried over from an old code identity); T02 remeasures only the affected paths

the five targeted M1 acceptance checks of m1_rule; then every T01 part rerun and merged under the new code hash

landing_choices.choice: condition diagonal_mixture__m032__rho0p75; the five families, MF_VCS_M1 at each cap 10 / 30 / 100 so that every cap's full training cost is measured (7 rows); lr 3e-4 (middle candidate) for every smoke row; data root seed 20261016 (the package generator's default seed, neither the tuning suite nor a formal suite); algo seed 1017; outputs never enter any selection; not part of the 1212
landing_choices.why: the decision fixes 'one condition, five families, actual full training cost' but not the condition, lr or data seed; m = 32 with the full-rank diagonal_mixture structure and the largest dependence is the most demanding case for the training loop; a dedicated data seed keeps the tuning and formal suites untouched

landing_choices.choice: T03_<SMK|CAL|MAIN|ALGO|CAP>_<n> and BF1_<method>_lr<lr>[_cap<cap>] / BF1_<method>_s<seed>, numbered in the frozen orders listed in t03.units_file.order
lr / cap = CAL (inherit the CAL selection of the same condition and method) or CAL_K16 (capacity rows); NA where not applicable; depends_on lists the gating unit ids

within a family, candidates are launched and charged against the per-family cap in the frozen candidate order, so a budget cut is deterministic; parallel scheduling does not change the order of accounting

stop_reason uses the phase-1 solver statuses gap_tolerance / iteration_budget_exhausted plus zero_reference_gap; converged is true for zero_reference_gap (W = 0 is the exact maximiser); tolerance_effective and gap_relative_to_zero are null there
